401-2842-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2842-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Repeat.

1052-6553-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1349-4153-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-4153-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Resourceful Defense's ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 1.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Resourceful Defense.
When Resourceful Defense dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Resourceful Defense from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Evereth ability from step 6.
Repeat.
1349-4153-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-4247-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4247-7173.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1768-5641-6854.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Eldrazi Spawn.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 3.

4365-4772-6664-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2446-3259-5434.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2446-3259-5434.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1594-2146-2781-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Felidar Guardian from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

2103-6568-7757-7758.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
2103-6568-7757-7758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Blink Shivan Sand-Mage using Y'shtola Rhul.
When Shivan Sand-Mage enters, it triggers, removing two time counters from Capture of Jingzhou.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

6158-7675-7676.easyPrerequisites:
You can play a land this turn.
There is a land in your library that is fetchable by Blighted Woodland.
6158-7675-7676.description:
Cast Scale Up by paying {G}, targeting Tifa.
Play Blighted Woodland.
When Blighted Woodland enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn.
Activate Blighted Woodland by paying {3}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, searching your library for an applicable land and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the land enters, Tifa triggers, doubling its power until end of turn
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Tifa. That opponent loses the game due to being dealt 21 or more combat damage by your commander.

2239-3378-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}.
2239-3378-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying {3}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Peregrine Drake and causing you to draw a card.
When Ardent Elementalist and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
2239-3378-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

240-2438-4875.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-2438-4875.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-5644-7377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Judith
1618-2440-5644-7377.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Festering March.
Festering March triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Judith triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Festering March.
Repeat.
1618-2440-5644-7377.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Judith. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

2558-3000-6737-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

725-1329-2034-3661.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Shield Sphere, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Shield Sphere, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

2842-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2842-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

539-5226-7034.description:
Cast Bumi by paying its mana cost
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Bumi
When Bumi dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Bumi enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

874-2854-4574-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
Showdown of the Skalds' second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
874-2854-4574-6650.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2854-4574-6650.description:
Cast Delif's Cone either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}
Showdown of the Skalds triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Delif's Cone from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

147-2171-2921.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.
147-2171-2921.description:
Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet

390-1084-3108.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Hulking Metamorph.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Flourishing Defenses triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1350-5287-6753.notablePrerequisites: Dihada has at least four loyalty counters on it.
1350-5287-6753.description:
Activate Dihada's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to reveal the top four cards of your library and put them into your graveyard, and create eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{W}{W}{B}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Dihada from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dihada by paying {1}{R}{W}{B}.
Repeat.

1718-3327-4613-6461.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1718-3327-4613-6461.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
When Dargo enters the battlefield, Warden of the Grove triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Dargo.
Activate Dargo using Catalyst Elemental's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2196-2821-3756-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {U}.
2196-2821-3756-5803.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search by paying {2}{U}.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Frantic Search.
Resolve the copy of Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap Minamo, Izzet Boilerworks and another land.
Activate Izzet Boilerworks and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, untapping Kitsa.
Repeat from step 4.

Cast the artifact creature by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Together Forever triggers, returning the artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1336-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1336-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Heronblade Elite's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.

1385-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

1754-2292-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Guan Yu.
1754-2292-4766-5683.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Guan Yu.
When Guan Yu dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Guan Yu trigger, causing you to shuffle it into your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Guan Yu and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Guan Yu from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

526-1235-4200.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken non-Warrior creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1235-4200.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart.
When the Icewind Stalwart token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any non-Warrior you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Icewind Stalwart token.
Repeat from step 2.

222-2292-4871-5221.description:
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Sporuting Thrinax and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Sprouting Thrinax die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice and Sprouting Thrinax triggers once.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sprouting Thrinax trigger, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing two Saprolings.
When the Saprolings die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer abilities from steps 1 and 5, causing you to scry 1 four times.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enter the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
